description: This file defines the WindowSpec class and associated methods for window functions in Spark, including creation, partitioning, ordering, frame boundaries, and windowed column operations.

classes.name: WindowSpec
classes.description: S4 class representing a window specification in Spark, backed by a Java object reference.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes a WindowSpec object with a Java object reference.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the WindowSpec object as a string.

methods.name: partitionBy
methods.description: Defines partitioning columns for the window specification.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Defines ordering columns for the window specification.

methods.name: rowsBetween
methods.description: Sets frame boundaries based on row offsets.

methods.name: rangeBetween
methods.description: Sets frame boundaries based on value ranges.

methods.name: over
methods.description: Defines a windowing column based on a Column and WindowSpec.
